evidence:
Requirement->criterion map built from instruction.md + hireops_rules.md against the 2 gates, 42 Functional, 5 Polish and 5 Visual criteria. Almost every stated promise maps: job opening/validation (hro_job_open), add candidate + bottom of Applied (hro_add_candidate), email rules (hro_add_email_rules), one-stage moves non-drag (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), shared manual order (hro_reorder, hro_restart), reject/reason/rejected-from (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired), reopen + undo restores reason (hro_reopen), Interview places/re-order/freed place/undo overfill (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_undo_full), put back + reason + focus (hro_refused_put_back), HM/observer/candidate/anonymous permissions (hro_mgr_*, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous), stale 409 naming who (hro_stale_refused), bulk all-or-none/board order/places (hro_bulk_*), undo semantics (hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_once), Activity + refusals (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), notes (hro_notes), live board within 15 s (hro_live_board) with preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll (hro_pol_live_board), conversations (hro_msg_exchange, hro_msg_compose, hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place, hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up, hro_seen, hro_thread_access), drafts incl. session end and other user on browser (hro_drafts, hro_pol_live_thread, hro_pol_session_resume), failed send + note draft reload (hro_pol_failed_send), candidate view/wording/privacy/link (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private, hro_candidate_linked), restart without reseed (hro_restart). Runtime items (PORT, DB_PATH, /api/health, Node/Express/SQLite, cwd-independent paths) are shared harness/launch policy, not browser-gradable, and are correctly left to the launch/gate rather than criteria.

GAP 1 (the Fail, P2): undo refusal when a card was re-ordered, rejected or reopened since. instruction.md:3 'undo my last move ... as long as nobody has touched those cards since'; hireops_rules.md:98-99 'Undo is refused, changing nothing, if any of those cards has been moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened since, by anyone'. The only exercised trigger is another person changing a card's stage: functional/prompt.md:35 step (10)-(11) 'As Mei Lin ... move X back to Screen. As Rafael try to undo the V-and-X move ... refused'; judge.toml hro_undo_conflict 'after another person moves one card of Rafael's last move, Rafael's undo is refused'. No protocol step re-orders, rejects or reopens a card of a pending undoable move before an undo attempt (B step 3 re-order is Rafael's own later action and is never followed by an undo of the earlier move; L's undo refusal is driven by overfill, not touch). So the 're-ordered since' leg of a requirement stated in the top-level prompt has no evidence in any criterion.

GAP 2 (Note): stale-conflict presentation. instruction.md:3 'when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who' and hireops_rules.md:79-80 'The person is told ... by whom, and their board shows the card where it really is'. hro_stale_refused is graded on a page.evaluate replay (prompt.md:33) and accepts the name 'in the response or on screen'; the board's put-back after a 409 is not observed for this path. Generic put-back/reason/focus is graded by hro_refused_put_back on the Interview-full path, so an app with one generic refusal handler is covered; the residual (UI never surfaces the name) is a feasibility-justified softening because a UI-originated stale move needs a race against the live update. Recorded, not counted as the blocker.

GAP 3 (Note, minor legs not exercised): (a) hireops_rules.md:31 candidate 'source' is never read back (hro_add_candidate checks name and email only); (b) hireops_rules.md:138 'A message is plain text' - no criterion checks that markup in a message is shown literally; (c) hireops_rules.md:21-23 status 403 for role refusals and 409 for stale moves are graded only as 'refused' (401 and 404 are checked); (d) hireops_rules.md:71-72 HM reject from Offer / reopen restricted to Interview-or-Offer origin not exercised (only Interview); (e) hireops_rules.md:165 candidate message seen by the job's hiring manager not exercised (only Rafael); (f) hireops_rules.md:18 Observer reading Activity not exercised; (g) hireops_rules.md:121 'text they are typing anywhere' exercised only for the note box and reply box. These are bundled-flow legs or API detail; per the skill's flow false positive I do not count them as blockers, but they are reported because the row requires every gap.

No runtime evidence touches these legs: raw-evidence-index.json scope says the scripted golden driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would' and no configured judge run exists, so coverage here is a source-level finding.
counterexample: A plausible broken app that implements undo by checking only that each card's stage still equals the move's destination stage (no version bump on re-order). Scenario the rules require to be refused: Rafael moves W and X from Applied to Screen together; Mei Lin re-orders X above W within Screen; Rafael clicks Undo -> the app restores W and X to Applied, silently discarding Mei's re-order, violating hireops_rules.md:98 and instruction.md:3. This app passes hro_undo_conflict (Mei's stage move of X is detected), hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_once and hro_undo_full, and every other criterion, so the violated requirement goes ungraded. The same app could also ignore an intervening reject+reopen round trip that returns the card to the same stage.
suggested_fix: Add one leg to protocol B and hro_undo_conflict: after a successful multi-card move by Rafael, Mei Lin re-orders one of those cards within its stage (no stage change), and Rafael's undo (UI and replay) must be refused with nothing changed; optionally note the 403/409, plain-text and source legs in existing criteria if workload allows.
